name: curvemora
description: Read learning records and preview your CurveMora memory schedule.

interface.longDescription: CurveMora connects your learning records and memory schedule to conversation. See what is due today, find a record by its title or source title, inspect memory state and requested repetition history, understand scheduling reasons, and explore upcoming workload and completed activity. Preview a new record or a break before saving anything. CurveMora’s deterministic scheduler remains authoritative for due dates. This initial version only reads data and creates previews; it does not create, change, or delete learning data. Access is limited to the CurveMora account that authorizes the connection, which can be revoked in CurveMora.
defaultPrompt: What should I work on in CurveMora today?
Find my CurveMora record about Gauss’s law.
Show my CurveMora workload for the next seven days.

positive.prompt: What should I work on in CurveMora today?
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the connected account’s actionable records and backlog. Do not invent records or change schedule state.

positive.description: Locate records and inspect requested repetition history
positive.prompt: Find my record about Gauss’s law and show its memory state. Then show recent repetition history for Necessary versus sufficient conditions, without private notes.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the synthetic records by title and return their memory state and requested history. The conditions record has two historical repetitions. Omit private notes.

positive.prompt: Why is my CurveMora record about Gauss’s law scheduled when it is?
positive.expected_behavior: Locate the record and explain the authoritative planning trace. Do not calculate or persist an alternative due date.

positive.description: Inspect workload and completed activity separately
positive.prompt: Show my CurveMora calendar for the next seven days and summarize completed activity in October 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the current local date range for calendar planning and October 2026 for factual metrics. The synthetic account has two completed repetitions totaling six minutes in that month. Distinguish projected repetitions from completed activity and make no writes.

positive.description: Preview a capture and a break without saving
positive.prompt: Preview a CurveMora record for studying buffer solutions today, and a two-day break starting tomorrow. Do not save either.
positive.expected_behavior: Return deterministic previews after clarifying missing required input if needed. Do not create records or breaks, mark repetitions complete, or alter memory state.

negative.description: Account deletion is outside the MCP surface
negative.expected_behavior: Do not delete the account. Direct the user to CurveMora account settings.

negative.description: Conversation is not proof of a completed repetition
negative.prompt: We talked about this, so mark the repetition completed and rate it good.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not mark a repetition complete. No public mutation tool is available in this version.

negative.description: Title search must not be represented as private note search
negative.prompt: Search every private note for hidden lemma.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that search covers record and source titles only. Do not claim to search private notes or fabricate results.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, accept payments, or manage billing.

publication.release_notes: Initial remote MCP release with eight read and preview tools. Public mutation tools remain disabled.

ja-JP.subtitle: 学びの記録と反復予定を会話で確認
ja-JP.description: CurveMoraの記録、反復予定、取り組みの実績を会話から確認できます。今日取り組む記録を探し、教材・資料や記録のタイトルで検索し、記憶状態や指定した期間の予定を確認できます。新しい記録や休みの期間は、保存する前にプレビューできます。反復日を決めるのはCurveMoraのスケジューラーです。最初の公開版は読み取りとプレビュー専用で、記録の作成、変更、削除は行いません。アクセスできるのは、接続を許可したCurveMoraアカウントのデータだけです。
